Assets → Import Workbench metadata → Select project and sidecars opens two native file pickers: choose addon.gproj, then up to 500 .meta files inside that project. The worker reads supported identities only. Review resource paths, GUIDs, empty/missing target warnings and dependency gaps; use the warning filter and pages. Export resource index saves the reviewed metadata. Use reviewed resource index makes it available in unit property review and invalidates any older property review. Neither action edits the mission or spawns game entities. Cancellation or rejected files retain the previous metadata review. Clear metadata review affects this panel only; clear the property source index separately if needed. Restart clears session metadata. Native loading, component configurations and server availability remain unverified.
